fair_value.method: Sum of the parts on 3.95B shares (corrected from 3.54B): core auto+energy ~$2.25 2027E EPS (consensus $2.17, small premium for energy) x 45 = ~$101; FSD/robotaxi option ~$500B = ~$127/sh (trimmed from $530B for the NHTSA Special Order and EU vote slip); Optimus/AI/Terafab option ~$210B = ~$53; net cash $27.4B = ~$7. Total ~$288, rounded to $290, ~22% below spot. Cross-check: $2.17 x 130x = ~$282.

bear.story: Core auto margins stay near 16% with GAAP operating margin in low single digits, >$25B/yr capex keeps FCF negative and adds debt; the NHTSA Special Order leads to a Cybercab pause or FMVSS exemption process (no foot brake, FMVSS 135), EU FSD approval stalls, robotaxi expansion misses the ~12-state goal; the multiple compresses well below the July low.

base.story: Deliveries flat to modestly up in 2027, energy keeps growing, robotaxi expands to more metros and states but stays immaterial to revenue; EPS ~$2.2; the stock stays range-bound ($290-450) on narrative and ends slightly below today's level, reflecting a fundamental anchor ~$290 but durable optionality premium.

bull.story: Cybercab clears NHTSA with no forced pause, unsupervised robotaxi scales to ~12+ states with visible per-mile economics, EU FSD approved in 2027, AI5 and Optimus show real volume, and a SpaceX tie-up or similar re-rates the Musk ecosystem; stock retakes and exceeds the $499 high.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$250 (about 16% under the July-2026 low of $297-304, which already priced a 1.4% operating margin and negative FCF, and ~33% below spot) the market would most likely be pricing an impaired autonomy thesis (NHTSA forcing a Cybercab pause or exemption process after the Special Order, a serious robotaxi incident, or unsupervised expansion stalling) and/or core auto turning loss-making while debt-funded capex continues, not ordinary 46%-vol noise. I keep $250 rather than a higher level because with my fair value now ~$290, trading in the $255-290 zone would just be convergence to fundamentals, not proof of a broken thesis.

key_uncertainties: Outcome of the NHTSA Cybercab Special Order: fine is immaterial (~$139M max) but a pause or exemption process would delay scaling
Pace of unsupervised robotaxi expansion beyond 7 TX/FL metros (~200 unsupervised vehicles today)

Whether core auto margins recover from 16.3% ex-credits and GAAP operating margin of 1.4%
Return on >$25B/yr capex and financing (up to $30B debt) vs negative FCF

reasoning: Round 2 revision. The supervisor showed I used 3.54B shares; StockAnalysis confirms 3.95B shares and a $1.47T market cap at $372.11 (net cash $27.4B, $6.95/sh), so my per-share SOTP was ~11% too high. Consensus 2027 EPS is $2.17 (not my ~$2.40), putting the stock at ~171x 2027 EPS. I also confirmed that NHTSA escalated the Cybercab probe to a Special Order with a sworn response due Sept 30 (live near-term left-tail risk) and that the EU FSD vote slipped from Oct 6 to December at the earliest, with the 65%-population threshold unattainable without France/Germany/Italy/Spain. Recomputed fair value: SOTP ~$288 and a 130x P/E cross-check ~$282, so ~$290, about 22% below spot. As in round 1, I do not expect fair value to bind within 12 months: TSLA trades on optionality, analyst targets average ~$397 (median $415; 19 Buy, 20 Hold, 4 Sell), and robotaxi expansion toward ~12 states is a plausible upside catalyst, so I move the median only modestly lower, to ~$360 (P(>=372)=0.47 vs 0.505 in round 1). I accept the supervisor's point that my tails were too thin given 1.84 beta, 46% realized vol, TSLA's -65%/+100% historical annual moves, and real binary events (NHTSA, robotaxi scaling, SpaceX). The ladder is now a lognormal mixture: bear 27% median $255 sigma 0.45; base 48% median $362 sigma 0.34; bull 25% median $510 sigma 0.42 (effective sigma ~0.5, mean ~$400 from right skew), with the far tails lightly fattened for binary risk. I keep my thesis break at $250 rather than moving up, because a lower fair value makes the $255-290 zone a fundamental convergence zone rather than a break signal. No option prices, implied volatility or priors files were consulted.
